description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget called QuizzesScreen, which displays a list of quiz previews within a mobile app UI. It includes UI components such as OceanCard and SectionTitle, and constructs a list view with quiz items, each with difficulty chips and icons.

classes.name: QuizzesScreen
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that builds the UI for the Quizzes tab, showing a list of quiz previews with different difficulties and icons.

methods.name: _difficultyChip
methods.description: Creates a styled container widget representing the difficulty level as a colored chip.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the main widget tree of the QuizzesScreen, including a list view with static quiz entries.

methods.name: buildQuiz
methods.description: Helper method for constructing individual quiz preview widgets with a standard OceanCard layout, including icon, title, question count, difficulty, and color.
